decisions.name: 中海发展
reasoning: The broad hub first surfaced record Chinese crude stockpiling, which maps directly into seaborne crude volume and tanker utilization.

Company H1 evidence already showed recurring conversion: tonne-miles +29.2%, main revenue +20.3%, attributable profit turned positive from a large prior-year loss, and oil-shipping gross margin improved from -5.1% to +14.3%.
Foreign crude-shipping revenue rose 35.6% and its gross margin improved from -30.1% to +4.3%, making the causal bridge company-specific rather than thematic.
Price absorption was meaningful but not extreme: 20/60/120d excess versus CSI300 about +8.8/+12.4/+14.0pp.
Global tanker oversupply and the potentially temporary nature of strategic stockpiling prevent High-priority status.

decisions.name: 中国铁建
reasoning: Generalist hub coverage showed expanding railway funding/project approvals and overseas railway activity.
Q3 company evidence closed the loop: 1-9M overseas new contracts +244%, railway-engineering contracts +75%, urban-rail contracts +91%, with a very large backlog.
The operating bridge is order-based and recurring across many projects rather than a single contract.
Price absorption was already substantial: 20/60/120d excess about +17.9/+18.5/+22.8pp, so the signal is not clean enough for High-priority.
The company still had a low-valuation infrastructure profile and a multi-year backlog, which keeps it eligible for Research rather than forcing a crowdedness rejection.

decisions.name: 中国南车
reasoning: Q3 operating conversion was very strong: revenue +50%, attributable profit +58%, ex-item profit +67%, driven mainly by higher EMU and metro deliveries.
However the stock was suspended from Oct-27 for a major corporate action and was not executable at the Oct-31 evidence-closed checkpoint.
A valid economic thesis cannot count as an opportunity week when the listed expression cannot be traded.

decisions.name: 兴业证券
reasoning: The record-turnover/Stock Connect incidence to brokerage revenue is direct and the company had meaningful brokerage market share.
But fresh Q4 brokerage revenue attributable to the new flow was not yet publicly reported at the checkpoint.
Price absorption was already extreme: 20/60/120d excess about +22.5/+45.8/+70.1pp.
v3.3 therefore records a mapped but evidence-latent candidate instead of promoting it for frequency.
The cleanest transaction-service incidence lacked a sufficiently direct and contemporaneously measurable A-share expression; developers were too indirect.
Broad liquidity/rate easing did not isolate a unique company earnings bridge separate from already-mapped capital-market and housing channels.
The policy signal was real, but no H2 company order/revenue conversion was frozen without importing later evidence.
The merger narrative was inseparable from the same strong rolling-stock delivery cycle and would duplicate a non-executable expression.

shadowControls.reason: Mapped direct exposure but no fresh operating conversion and extreme price absorption.
